Material Options

Shutter Options

Laminated / Acrylic / Glass / Veneer / PU Finish / PVC Laminate / Aristo Brand shutters available on HDHMR Exterior grade HDF or Marine Plywood.

Shutter

Both side Laminated HDHMR Exterior grade HDF Board with matching edge banding on sides.

Carcass

Both side cold pressed laminated marine grade plywood BWP (Boiling Water Proof) with water resistance testing after 72hrs of boiling, edge banded 18mm.

Skirting & Fittings

Laminated skirting. SS fittings with Hettich accessories throughout.

Edge Banding

All four sides on the carcass and shutter with corner rounding wherever applicable. Premium edge banding tapes.

Carcass Back & Sink

Hylam sheet back panel. Sink cabinet & wash counters: 17mm PVC Foam board with smooth matte finish. Tolerance: +/−1mm.

Marine Plywood

Famous Brand. WPC: Demac / Thomson. Laminate: Greenlam / Newmika / Merrino / Amulya.

Accessories

Hettich premium hardware and fittings throughout the project for lasting quality and performance.
